items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 23 at 2:24AM EDT until October 25 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts to 35 kt and seas
6 to 10 ft expected.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina and Northeast South Carolina
coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 8 PM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
